{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders — they are not completed sales
# Conversion rate is defined as: completed orders / total orders (only completed ones count)
# So we must exclude refunded orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
total_by_channel = completed_df.groupby('channel').size()
converted_by_channel = completed_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()

# Conversion rate = number of converted orders / total completed orders by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = converted_by_channel / total_by_channel

# Difference: email minus paid_search
email_rate = conversion_rate_by_channel['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f'Completed orders by channel:\n{total_by_channel}')
print(f'Converted orders by channel:\n{converted_by_channel}')
print(f'Conversion rates:\n{conversion_rate_by_channel}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}')"}
